name: stock-sst-upwind-unchanged-residual-continuation
objective: Determine whether the clean SA-to-stock-SST upwind replication satisfies the already declared Uy residual gate after additional unchanged iterations, without changing its mesh, physics, model, fields, boundary conditions, convection schemes, solvers, relaxation, forces, or thresholds.

trigger.observed_failure: Final Uy initial residual 2.380820461e-05 and final-100 maximum 2.560585195e-05 exceed the unchanged 1e-5 limit; all other numerical-entry gates pass.
prohibited_conditions: NaN or infinity in fields, residuals, or force history
source case or audit digest mismatch

fixed_invariants: Copy the final U, p, k, omega, and nut fields plus every mesh, transport, turbulence, scheme, solver, relaxation, decomposition, and force-definition file unchanged. Only FoamFile locations, start/end times, output directories, and provenance metadata may change.

unchanged_gates.settling: final-100 peak-to-peak <= max(0.001, 1% of absolute coefficient mean)
unchanged_gates.trend: projected absolute change over 500 iterations within Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002
unchanged_gates.residuals: final-100 maximum initial residual <= 1e-5 for p, Ux, Uy, k, and omega
unchanged_gates.zero_angle_symmetry: absolute mean Cl <= 0.004 and absolute mean quarter-chord CmPitch <= 0.0002
unchanged_gates.force_agreement: absolute mean Cd minus NASA CFL3D SST Cd <= 0.0002

decision_rule: Run exactly one unchanged 5000-iteration continuation. It may seed the exact-SSTm rung only if provenance, invariant, runtime, model, finite-history, horizon, settling, trend, residual, and symmetry gates pass. NASA agreement remains reportable and required for the relative stock-SST rung, while strict validation remains blocked by failed Gate 1. No threshold or numerical control may be changed after observing the result.
